{{Short description|Romanian mathematician}}
[[File:Florian Pop.jpg|thumb|Florian Pop at [[Mathematical Research Institute of Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]] in 2006]]
'''Florian Pop''' (born 1952 in [[Zalău]]) is a [[Romania]]n mathematician, a [[mathematician|professor of mathematics]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]].

Pop received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in 1987<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=44604}}</ref> and his [[habilitation]] in 1991, both from the [[University of Heidelberg]]. He has been a member of the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in [[Princeton, New Jersey|Princeton]], and (from 1996 to 2003) a professor at the [[University of Bonn]] prior to joining the University of Pennsylvania faculty.<ref name="cv">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.upenn.edu/~pop/BriefCV.html|title= Pop's CV from his University of Pennsylvania web site}}</ref>

Pop's research concerns [[algebraic geometry]], [[arithmetic geometry]], [[anabelian geometry]], and [[Galois theory]]. {{harvtxt|Kuhlmann|Kuhlmann|Marshall|2003}} call his habilitation thesis, concerning the [[Characterization (mathematics)|characterization]] of certain [[field (mathematics)|fields]] by their [[absolute Galois group]]s, a "milestone".<ref>{{citation|title=Valuation Theory and Its Applications|volume=2|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|year=2003|page=v|isbn=978-0-8218-3206-6|first1=Franz-Viktor|last1=Kuhlmann|first2=Salma|last2=Kuhlmann|first3=Murray|last3=Marshall}}.</ref>

In 1996, Pop was awarded the [[Gay-Lussac&ndash;von Humboldt Prize]] for Mathematics,<ref>[https://media.education.gouv.fr/file/Brochures/77/6/listelaureatsall12-2_25776.pdf List of Gay-Lussac&ndash;von Humboldt Prize Prize winners], accessed on 2009-10-25.</ref> and in 2003 he was awarded the [[National Order of Merit (Romania)|Romanian Order of Merit]], Commander rank.<ref name="cv"/><ref>{{citation| url=https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/44401| title=Decret nr. 370 din 11 iunie 2003| language=ro|work=[[Monitorul Oficial]]| issue=420|date=June 16, 2003|access-date=May 28, 2025}}</ref> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-05-26.</ref>
